    StartersKimberly's road trip pretzel bitesSoft pretzel bites with flaky salt and a sweet honey mustard dipHow to make it500g pizza dough1.5 L water60g bicarbonate of soda1 egg, beaten1 tsp sea salt flakes3 tbsp dijon mustard3 tbsp honey2 tbsp mayonnaiseHeat the oven to 220°C and line a tray with baking paper.Roll the dough into 4 long ropes and cut into 3cm bites.Bring the water and bicarb to the boil and boil the bites for 30 seconds in batches, then drain.Lay on the tray, brush with egg and sprinkle with the salt.Bake until deep brown.Mix the mustard, honey and mayonnaise and serve with the warm bites.Death's design devilled eggsHard-boiled eggs filled with a creamy yolk, mustard and mayonnaise mix, with smoked paprika and chivesHow to make it8 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp dijon mustard1 tsp white vinegar1/4 tsp salt1/2 tsp smoked paprika1 tbsp chives, snippedLower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.Cool in iced water.Peel, halve lengthways and scoop the yolks into a bowl.Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and salt until smooth and pipe back into the whites.Dust with the paprika and scatter with chives.MainsEvan's jackpot spaghetti and meatballsPork and beef meatballs simmered in a basil tomato sauce over spaghetti with parmesanHow to make it60g breadcrumbs60ml milk300g beef mince300g pork mince1 egg40g parmesan, grated, for the meatballs1 garlic clove, crushed, for the meatballs1 tsp salt2 tbsp olive oil1 onion, diced2 garlic cloves, sliced, for the sauce700g tomato passata1 bunch basil400g spaghetti40g parmesan, grated, for servingSoak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the beef and pork mince, egg, parmesan for the meatballs, the crushed garlic and half the salt. Roll into 20 balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil in a wide pan and lift out.Soften the onion and sauce garlic in the pan, add the passata, the basil stalks and the rest of the salt, return the meatballs and simmer.Meanwhile cook 400g spaghetti in well salted boiling water until al dente and drain.Toss the spaghetti with a little sauce, top with the meatballs, torn basil leaves and the parmesan for serving.Kat Jennings' Route 23 chicken caesar wrapsKat's on the phone the whole way down Route 23How to make it600g chicken breast4 rashers of bacon1 cos lettuce, shredded40g parmesan, shaved4 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise1 lemon1 garlic clove, crushed1 tsp Dijon mustard4 large soft wraps250g cherry tomatoes1 Lebanese cucumber1 tbsp olive oilMix the mayonnaise, a squeeze of lemon, garlic, mustard and half the parmesan for the dressing.Rub the chicken with oil and salt and grill until cooked, then rest and slice. Fry the bacon until crisp.Toss the cos with the dressing and the rest of the parmesan.Fill the wraps with the lettuce, chicken and crumbled bacon, roll tight and halve. Serve with tomatoes and cucumber.SweetsSpring break key lime pieCrisp biscuit base, tangy lime and condensed milk filling, whipped cream on topHow to make it250g plain sweet biscuits, crushed100g butter, melted395g can sweetened condensed milk4 egg yolks6 limes, zested and juiced300ml thickened cream1 tbsp icing sugarHeat the oven to 170°C. Mix the biscuit crumbs with the butter and press into a 23cm pie tin.Bake the base.Whisk the condensed milk, egg yolks, lime zest and 150ml lime juice until smooth.Pour into the base and bake until just set.Cool, then chill.Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread over the pie.DrinksDaytona Beach rum punchGolden rum with pineapple, orange and lime over ice, with a grenadine sunsetHow to make it180ml golden rum500ml pineapple juice250ml orange juice2 limes, juiced2 tbsp grenadine1 bag ice1 orange, slicedStir the rum, pineapple juice, orange juice and lime juice in a jug.Chill.Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses, drizzle in the grenadine so it sinks and add an orange slice.
